All Implemented Interfaces:
com.google.protobuf.Message, com.google.protobuf.MessageLite, com.google.protobuf.MessageLiteOrBuilder, com.google.protobuf.MessageOrBuilder, Serializable, FilePartOrBuilder
@Generated public final class FilePart extends com.google.protobuf.GeneratedMessage implements FilePartOrBuilder
 FilePart represents the different ways files can be provided. If files are
 small, directly feeding the bytes is supported via file_with_bytes. If the
 file is large, the agent should read the content as appropriate directly
 from the file_with_uri source.
Protobuf type a2a.v1.FilePart
